decision: Require grz_clean. Among development policies, WISE S/N>=20 improves direct final-modulus NMAD at r=19-20/20-21/21-22 by 0.023/0.016/0.024 mag relative to the clean highest-available policy, with selected fractions 0.926/0.912/0.827 versus 0.929/0.913/0.837. The strict-quality policy reaches 0.302 mag NMAD at r=21-22 but selects only 0.568. Freeze WISE20 before reading calibration/final simulation residuals.
